verses.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
verses.pt: Diz o néscio no seu coração: Não há Deus. Corromperam-se e cometeram abominável iniqüidade; não há quem faça o bem.
verses.en_web: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to Mahalath. Maschil. Of David.> The foolish man has said in his heart, God will not do anything. They are unclean, they have done evil works; there is not one who does good.

verses.en: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
verses.pt: Deus olha lá dos céus para os filhos dos homens, para ver se há algum que tenha entendimento, que busque a Deus.
verses.en_web: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
verses.en_bbe: God was looking down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who had wisdom, searching after God.

verses.en: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.pt: Desviaram-se todos, e juntamente se fizeram imundos; não há quem faça o bem, não há sequer um.
verses.en_web: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
verses.en_bbe: Every one of them has gone back; they are unclean: there is not one who does good, no, not one.

verses.en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
verses.pt: Acaso não têm conhecimento os que praticam a iniqüidade, os quais comem o meu povo como se comessem pão, e não invocam a Deus?
verses.en_web: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
verses.en_bbe: Have the workers of evil no knowledge? they take my people for food, as they would take bread; they make no prayer to God.

verses.en: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.
verses.pt: Eis que eles se acham em grande pavor onde não há motivo de pavor, porque Deus espalhará os ossos daqueles que se acampam contra ti; tu os confundirás, porque Deus os rejeitou.
verses.en_web: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.
verses.en_bbe: They were in great fear, where there was no cause for fear: for the bones of those who make war on you have been broken by God; you have put them to shame, because God has no desire for them.

verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.pt: Oxalá que de Sião viesse a salvação de Israel! Quando Deus fizer voltar os cativos do seu povo, então se regozijará Jacó e se alegrará Israel.
verses.en_web: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.en_bbe: May the salvation of Israel come out of Zion! When the fate of his people is changed by God, Jacob will have joy, and Israel will be glad.
